program='''import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def transform(grid):
    a = np.array(grid)
    h, w = a.shape
    labels, _ = ndimage.label(a != 1)
    sr, sc = np.argwhere(a == 6)[0]
    component = labels == labels[sr, sc]
    solid = ndimage.binary_fill_holes(component)
    padded = np.pad(solid, 1)
    edge = np.zeros_like(component)
    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
            if dr or dc:
                shifted = padded[1+dr:1+dr+h, 1+dc:1+dc+w]
                edge |= component & ~shifted
    out = np.full_like(a, 8)
    # Keep only blue objects belonging to the outlined region or its boundary.
    near = ndimage.binary_dilation(component, structure=np.ones((3, 3)))
    out[(a == 1) & (solid | near)] = 1
    out[edge] = 7
    out[sr, sc] = 6
    return out.tolist()
'''
py.write_text(program);js.write_text(json.dumps(pairs))
